description: AAASM-5353, added after delta review: a context keyword is evidence about the category it names and nothing else. Pooling the keyword sets let the phone label 電話 exempt a machine-delimited 8-digit run from the tax recognizer's prose boundary rule, so an ordinary zh-TW contact record emitted a spurious TAX_IDENTIFIER beside the correct PHONE_NUMBER. Only the mobile number is a finding here.
